scripts.test:bdd: npx cucumber-js tests/features --require tests/step-definitions/**/*.js --require tests/hooks/**/*.js --require tests/support/**/*.js --format json:reports/cucumber.json
scripts.test:smoke: npx cucumber-js tests/features --tags "@smoke" --require tests/step-definitions/**/*.js --require tests/hooks/**/*.js --require tests/support/**/*.js --format json:reports/cucumber.json
scripts.test:regression: npx cucumber-js --tags "@regression" --require tests/step-definitions/**/*.js --require tests/hooks/**/*.js --require tests/support/**/*.js --format json:reports/cucumber.json
